story.title: Tennis the way we love it
paragraphs: Passing Shot began with second-hand gear: rackets and kit sourced one by one and brought back into play. That is where our wish was born to recapture the elegance of tennis as it once was — clubs, tournament posters and whites.

Little by little we turned to new products, to fully represent the brands we love: their craftsmanship as much as their values. Every season we select the best of their collections and offer it at the fairest price.
